877abc41a2beaa4d.summary: ATHENS, Sept 26 (Reuters) - Six people have died after a two-storey residential building in a tourist area of central Athens collapsed, ‌the Greek fire brigade said on Saturday, following an explosion ‌that the mayor said was likely linked to gas infrastructure. The explosion killed four Americans, US ​officials said.
